title: The roofline: a rising bandwidth roof, a flat compute roof, and where each phase sits
why: It shows the structure the prose builds in sequence: decode at intensity near 1 sits far under the bandwidth roof, prefill at about 130,000 sits under the compute roof, and the ridge where the two meet is about 295 FLOPs per byte on an H100.

series.label: decode: intensity near 1, 59.1 tok/s on this pair

note: Log-log. On an H100 SXM the roofs meet near 295 FLOPs per byte (989 TFLOP/s over 3.35 TB/s), so prefill is compute-bound and decode is bandwidth-bound.
